- `Landing.jsx` — 40px wordmark, "Join Now / Sign In" text links top-right, headline at 28.8vh with measured line spacing, email row = 382px input + 236px red button, footer at 6vh.

No visual browser exists in the sandbox, so fidelity is based on pixel measurements only — a human should compare the running app against the screenshots.
